apps.name: Nova Launcher
apps.whats_new: The Store checks itself now: open it and it fetches the online catalog on its own — no button to find first — then SPEAKS the whole verdict out loud: how many apps the store carries, exactly which of your apps have updates waiting and to which versions, and any brand-new apps by name. A check can no longer hang in silence: tight timeouts, a spoken 'still checking' warning if it drags, and a spoken reason if it can't reach the store. New 'Read store status aloud' button replays the verdict any time, and the store remembers its last check and shows it when you come back. Fixes the report that Check for updates hung with no rows and nothing heard.

apps.name: Nova Voice
apps.whats_new: Engine registration fix: Nova Voice now answers Android's engine-data checks (voice data check, sample text, install data) the way Google and Samsung's engines do — through 1.9 nothing answered those probes, and Nova never appeared in the Preferred engine lists. The app's top line now shows version 2.0 so you can confirm the update landed.

apps.name: Nova Phone
apps.whats_new: Speaker fix: speaker and mute now switch on the Telecom audio route itself, and Nova only says "Speaker on" once the call stack confirms it. Plus an in-call keypad for business phone menus and a one-tap Call Computer Revolution button on the Dialer tab.

apps.name: Nova Chat
apps.whats_new: Fixes the blank screen — the app now actually shows the Watch List and Chat Reader.

apps.name: Nova Stream
apps.whats_new: Stream from the phone with RTMP — Twitch and YouTube starter buttons.

apps.name: UHC Claim Builder
apps.whats_new: Receipt fix, part two: the build itself now heals missing receipts. If a trip you picked has no receipt, the app fetches it from Gmail on the spot and keeps building — no pull first, no trip left behind (the old repair stopped at 10 trips). If Gmail can't produce it either, the message now tells you the exact next step instead of just stopping.

apps.name: Fanciful Companion
apps.whats_new: Fanciful now borrows the Gemini key from the Launcher instead of asking you to paste it again, and no longer pops the key dialog up on its own.

apps.name: Nova House Log
apps.whats_new: NEW GroupMe tab: connect with your GroupMe token (dev.groupme.com) and the app watches the FH6-132 group chat. YOUR posts about Skye auto-log as counted entries — your phone, your consent. Janelle's lane is built but OFF: it stays off until she consents and you flip the switch; even then her posts only wait for her texted yes before anything is logged. Nobody else's messages are ever collected. Also new: date and time PICKERS everywhere (no more typing dates), and a test entry mode — practice entries save without confronting her, are badged TEST, never counted, and never appear in any report. The real save gate is unchanged.

apps.name: Nova Devotion
apps.whats_new: First release: a daily devotion on your phone — today's verse and reflection spoken in Nova's voice, all 14 banked devotions by ear, and a morning reminder if you want one.

apps.name: Pastor Nova
apps.whats_new: Key sharing with the Nova Launcher fixed: Ask Pastor Nova now borrows the Gemini key from the Launcher automatically — no pasting, no popup. The app declares the Launcher's key provider in its manifest (required on newer Android) and retries the borrow once if the provider is still waking up. If the key truly isn't set up yet, she says so plainly and tells you to open the Launcher's Nova assistant once — she never nags you with a paste box again. Same substitute-pastor framing, six tabs, sermons, lessons, survey, and prayers as 1.1.
